changes.title: Full hosting mode with the app store; dashboard add control; fixes from the browser pass on build 121
changes.detail:
Hosting - "Full" mode: an outer container with its own Docker engine runs the Supervisor, the core and every app as containers inside it (hosting/full, compose.full.yaml, host.bat --full, host.sh --full, a workflow job that publishes the outer image and is part of the publish-only-when-green rule). The Supervisor skips its systemd firewall step when the outer container has already protected the gateway. Proven on a throwaway copy: store, installs, ingress, backup and restore with apps, a core update, stop and start; the workflow job has not run.

Interface - A dashboard page that holds a single card says so in edit mode and offers the sections layout; a generated page offers an editable copy; the page uses the visible screen height. - From the browser pass on build 121: the statistics strip is used by six list pages; selection bar buttons, row checkboxes, notification buttons and dashboard add buttons are 44 px on touch; the bar clears the sub-tab row; long press on a tile opens the menu without taking over a configured hold action; readable bar and toast buttons; the toast stack clears the bottom bar; the type scale survives a reload and starts from the theme's sizes; support tick
changes.detail_yue: 今次大件事：多咗個「完整模式」，一個外殼入面自己開引擎，管理員、核心同每個 應用程式各自一格，應用商店、完整備份、真更新全部得，部電腦望落只係得一個 容器。儀表板單卡頁編輯嗰陣終於有嘢可以加。仲有瀏覽器逐版睇完之後嘅一輪 執漏：粒掣夠大、字睇得清、砌好咗冇人用嘅零件終於駁返上版面。

changes.title: Tests: define build-time values and form stubs so no unhandled errors are printed
changes.detail: One layout test file printed 135 unhandled errors on every run: a build-time value the bundler defines was missing from the test setup, and the test browser's form internals lack the validity methods that form-associated components call. Both are provided in test/setup.ts. The suite is unchanged (6,232 pass, 3 fail as before) and prints no unhandled errors, so a real one will stand out.
changes.detail_yue: 測試執手尾：每次跑都彈 135 行「冇人理嘅錯誤」，其實係測試環境少咗個建置 時先有嘅數值，同埋假瀏覽器唔識表單驗證。補返之後靜晒，真係有事先至會嘈。
